landingPage.headline: An agent that fills your highest-stakes forms, and shows its work first.
landingPage.subheadline: Sherma reads the form, rehearses the fill against a twin of it, asks only what it does not already know, and shows you exactly what will be submitted. Nothing reaches the real form until you say so.
featureTags: What you approve is what goes in

principle.heading:
Built to be trusted.
Governed by simulation.
principle.body: Sherma rehearses the full fill on a twin of the real form. What you approve is what executes.
principle.traceBody: Built for filings that cannot afford to be wrong, not demo theatre.
principle.guaranteesHeading: Six things that stay true on every form.

guarantees.title: Scoped to the form it was given
guarantees.body: Sherma touches the form and the records you assigned to it. Nothing else in your systems is in scope.

guarantees.title: Rehearsed before it is real
guarantees.body: The whole fill happens on a twin first. The live form is touched once, with an answer already known to be complete.

guarantees.title: Human approval at the point of no return
guarantees.body: Everything reversible runs automatically. Anything that cannot be undone waits for a person.

guarantees.title: The twin is the plan
guarantees.body: What you approve is byte for byte what gets submitted. If the form changes underneath, the approval is void and it comes back to you.

guarantees.title: Every answer has a source
guarantees.body: Which document, which colleague, which date. If anyone queries a figure later, you can show where it came from.

guarantees.title: Escalation, never silent failure
guarantees.body: Missing data does not get guessed. Sherma finds who knows and asks, by chat or by call, and tells you if it is stuck.

impact.heading:
Move the filing off your desk, not off
your radar.
impact.body: The work stops being something a person does and becomes something a person approves. That is the whole difference.

items.title: Answer once, reuse everywhere
items.body: What you confirm becomes part of your record. The next structurally similar form starts mostly answered.

metric.label: FIELDS FILLED WITHOUT ASKING YOU
metric.note: First form, fifth form, twentieth form. Illustrative.

items.title: Deadlines stop being a scramble
items.body: Sherma works overnight and at weekends. The last forty-eight hours are for reviewing, not assembling.

items.title: Control is kept, not traded away
items.body: Simulation, an explicit approval, and a record of every action. Nothing fires without you.

process.heading: How Sherma fills a form, start to finish.
process.body: Six steps. Sherma runs four of them without asking. The two marked for a person are the two where the decision cannot be handed over.

steps.title: Intake
steps.body: A form URL, a forwarded email, or a portal Sherma watches. It picks the form up and opens it.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.body: Sherma builds a twin of the form and works the entire fill against it. Field rules, conditional sections and document requirements all surface here, not at the deadline.

steps.title: Fill from what it knows
steps.body: Your record answers most of it. Every value carries its source, so you can see where a figure came from and when it was last confirmed.

steps.title: Ask for the gaps
steps.body: Only what it genuinely does not know. By chat, or by call if it is urgent and nobody has replied. It chases until it has the answer.

steps.title: Confirm the twin
steps.body: The completed form as it will be submitted. Change anything you want, then approve it. This is the point of no return, so it is yours.

steps.title: Execute and record
steps.body: Sherma fills the real form with the approved twin and returns a record of every field. Where a portal needs a personal login, it hands the finished form to you to send.

useCases.heading:
Built for the forms that
cannot afford to be wrong.
useCases.body: Same agent, same principle. What changes is the record it draws from and the portal it works against.

items.title: Tax & VAT returns
items.body: The same return, every quarter, for every client. Sherma opens the job from the filing calendar, builds the return from the bookkeeping record, and shows it as a twin before anything is filed.
steps: Job opened from the filing calendar
Twin confirmed, return ready to file
items.note: Tax portals require a personal government credential such as eHerkenning. Sherma prepares the return in full and the accountant files it under their own login. It will not sign as you.

items.title: Tenders & qualification
items.body: Selection questionnaires, qualification packs and tender responses that repeat the same company evidence while every deadline remains final.
steps: Pack assembled, win themes left to you

items.title: Supplier onboarding & registration
items.body: Every large customer invites you into their own portal. The same company details, certificates and policies, entered from scratch for each one.

items.title: Partner & channel claims
items.body: Marketing funds and co-op claims with proof of performance, one vendor format at a time, where missing the window means losing the allocation.
steps: Fund notice picked up from the inbox
Claim matched to that vendor’s format
Claim ready before the window closes

items.title: Grants & subsidies
items.body: Funding applications where organisational evidence repeats, eligibility must be proven, and project-specific questions still need the right person.
steps: Application ready ahead of the close

items.title: Certification & insurance renewals
items.body: Annual renewals that are predictable, evidence-heavy, and mostly unchanged from the last approved submission.

items.title: Your use case
items.body: Do not see your workflow? Describe the form, portal, or filing and we will scope a custom Sherma run around it.

customIntake.heading: CUSTOM WORKFLOW INTAKE
customIntake.body: Share the recurring form or portal that is slowing your team down. This demo keeps the brief in your browser and prepares an email handoff.
customIntake.note: Sample intake only · nothing is transmitted from this page
customIntake.successBody: Open your email client to send the pre-filled brief when you are ready.

workedExample.heading: Filing a quarterly return without the re-entry.
workedExample.body: The same principle, applied to the most repeated form there is. One template, one entity at a time, four times a year, forever.
workedExample.before: Someone gathers the figures, re-keys them into the return, checks them against the ledger, and files before the deadline. Every quarter, for every client, with nothing carried forward except a spreadsheet.
workedExample.after: Sherma opens the job from the filing calendar, builds the return from the ledger, asks only about the figures it cannot derive, and presents the completed return as a twin. The accountant checks it and files it under their own credential.

card.label: QUARTERLY RETURN
card.summary: Confirm three figures, then file it under your own credential.
card.note: Illustrative figures. Your own ratio is measured on the first return.

control.heading: Autonomy without losing accountability.
control.body: AI first at every step. A person enters at the one moment that cannot be undone, and only then.

points.title: Everything reversible is automatic
points.body: Reading, simulating, filling, chasing, assembling. No approval is needed for work that can simply be redone.

points.title: Everything irreversible stops
points.body: Submission is the point of no return, so it waits for you. Where a portal needs a personal credential, you hold it, not Sherma.

points.title: The twin you approve is the one that runs
points.body: If the live form changes after you approve, the approval is void and it comes back to you rather than executing anyway.

points.title: Stuck is a state, not a silence
points.body: If Sherma cannot finish something, it tells you which field and why, with time left to act on it.

leadCapture.heading: Bring one form you already fill.
leadCapture.body: Thirty minutes. We run Sherma against a real form from your own work and you compare the twin with what your team produced. No slides.

footer.tagline: Sherma reads recurring forms, finds the real gaps, and rehearses every fill for human approval before anything is generated or submitted.
